description: This file defines a Job class and related functions for reading, processing, and writing Gerber and Excellon PCB manufacturing files within a PCB design automation context. It includes file parsing, coordinate transformations, trimming, and output generation capabilities specific to Gerber and Excellon formats, as well as handling job layout and rotation.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a PCB manufacturing job, handling parsing of Gerber and Excellon files, managing layers, commands, apertures, and job extent calculations.

classes.name: JobLayout
classes.description: Wraps a Job instance with specific (x, y) position, facilitating layout placement, gerber and drill command output, and job operations like rotation.

methods.name: rotateJob
methods.description: Creates a new Job object obtained by rotating an existing job by specified degrees, supporting 90°, 180°, and 270° rotations with coordinate and aperture adjustments.
